description: Takes a list of clarification cases or rejected invoices and deliveries (supplier, error text, optionally minutes spent) and sorts every case into nine error types by keywords (order number missing or wrong, delivery note, invoice sent twice, price, quantity, late delivery, faulty or wrong goods, mandatory invoice details, bank details or address not reported). Returns the most frequent errors, the five suppliers with the most cases with hours and cost of clarification, the share of the top three, and a ready letter per supplier with three or more cases naming their three most frequent errors and the request for each. The cost uses your hourly rate and minutes per case; without them it assumes 45 euros per hour and 20 minutes per case and says so. For causes inside your own process use analyse_issues. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

hourly_rate_eur.description: Optional: internal cost per hour in euros. Default 45.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

minutes_per_case.description: Optional: minutes per case where the row gives none. Default 20.

rows.description: One row per case: supplier, error (free text), optionally minutes. German column names work too (lieferant, fehler, minuten).

name: supplier_error_profile
title: Supplier error profile: which supplier makes which errors in a list of clarification cases, what clearing them up costs, a ready letter per supplier
